Welcome to the Department of Statistics
Founded in 1974, The Department of Statistics at The Ohio State University has grown steadily over the last 50 years to become an internationally recognized hub of research in statistical science and of statistics education.
Upcoming Events
News
Statistics is one of the fastest growing professions in the United States. Statisticians are trained to understand data, uncertainty, and natural variation, as well as think critically and use evidence to solve complex problems.
